title: Amazon Builders' Library: Timeouts, retries, and backoff with jitter

chunks.title: Amazon Builders' Library: Timeouts, retries, and backoff with jitter
chunks.excerpt: A timeout or failure doesn't necessarily mean that side effects haven't happened. If doing the side effects multiple times is undesirable, a best practice is designing APIs to be idempotent, meaning they can be safely retried.

chunks.title: Amazon Builders' Library: Timeouts, retries, and backoff with jitter
chunks.excerpt: When failures are caused by overload, retries that increase load can make matters significantly worse.

chunks.title: Amazon Builders' Library: Timeouts, retries, and backoff with jitter
chunks.excerpt: To avoid this problem, we implement our clients to use backoff. This increases the time between subsequent retries, which keeps the load on the backend even.
